about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Who I am and what I do
about.p1: Hi! I'm Liu Qiujing (Tujia), from Tongren, Guizhou, an undergraduate in Electronic Information Science and Technology at the School of Big Data & Information Engineering, Guizhou University (Class of 2026). From PCB soldering and MCU development to AI toolchain practice, I like turning ideas into working things with my own hands.
about.p2: Recently I practiced AI document engineering during an enterprise internship: organizing 1,141 project documents into a three-tier knowledge base (raw text + OCR + indexed summaries) with DeepSeek. During university I won a national 2nd prize in the Higher Education Cup Advanced Drawing Contest and a provincial 1st prize in the Challenge Cup. I'm looking for AI application / toolchain development roles.

list.name: Smart Obstacle-Avoidance Inspection Car (Graduation Project)
list.desc: An STM32F407VET6-based smart inspection car with multi-sensor obstacle avoidance, live video streaming and Bluetooth control, built end-to-end independently.
list.arch:
STM32F407VET6 main controller
├─ HC-SR04 ×3 ── multi-direction ultrasonic ranging + median filter
├─ L298N ────── PWM motor drive
├─ ESP32-CAM ── WiFi video streaming → phone view
├─ HC05 ─────── Bluetooth commands → manual/auto mode interlock
├─ OLED ─────── mode & distance display
└─ Power: 12V → LM2596(5V) → AMS1117(3.3V) two-stage buck
list.result: Autonomously avoids single and continuous multi-obstacle paths at a 30 cm threshold; smooth phone video; responsive Bluetooth control; stable operation; 53-page thesis, defended
list.role: Independent developer: circuit design, PCB soldering, embedded firmware and system debugging done end-to-end alone

list.name: Enterprise Document Knowledge Base: AI-Driven Three-Tier Architecture
list.desc: Organized 1,141 enterprise project documents into a three-tier knowledge base (raw text + OCR + indexed summaries) maintained by a DeepSeek pipeline.
list.arch:
Source material (1,141 documents + screenshots)
├─ 01-Raw Text/ ── de-formatted text (numbered 0001~0214)
├─ 02-OCR/ ────── image text recognition & table parsing
└─ 00-Index & Summaries/ ── index mapping + themed summaries
Pipeline: read → extract → OCR → summarize → archive (DeepSeek session)
list.result: Covers daily/weekly reports, 12 special projects, training & product materials; powers daily document processing and report generation; key playbooks searchable by number
list.role: Designed and maintained independently: defined the three-tier structure, wrote the PowerShell pipeline, ran extraction and summaries via DeepSeek sessions

list.name: PythonKnowledgeGenerator: AI Knowledge Production Pipeline
list.desc: A DeepSeek API-driven Python knowledge generator with layered architecture, resume-from-breakpoint, log tracking and quality stats.
list.arch:
Config/Topics.json (task library)
  ↓ Build-Prompt ──── generates prompts
  ↓ Invoke-DeepSeek ── HTTP API call
  ↓ Output ────────── categorized Markdown knowledge base
Cache ── resume state    Logs ── run logs    Config ── settings
list.result: Batch-generates a categorized Python knowledge base; resumes from breakpoint without wasting tokens; iterated V1→V3 (6 script versions) with quality reports
list.role: Independent developer: 6 versions from V1 to V3.3.1; designed resume-from-breakpoint, logging and quality stats
